title_highlights: 纳斯卡新任CEO史蒂夫·菲尔普斯

subtitles.en: Tyler and Steve, thank you so much for being here.
subtitles.zh: 泰勒、史蒂夫，非常感谢你们到来。

subtitles.en: I'm so excited to have you here. And I was just speaking with some of your team in the back saying, you know, I think more people are fans of NASCAR Motorsport than they think.
subtitles.zh: 非常高兴你们能来。我刚和你们团队的人聊过，我觉得喜欢纳斯卡赛车的人比大家以为的要多。

subtitles.en: They might be NASCAR curious. So my goal is that you come out of this conversation with more NASCAR fans that we had going in.
subtitles.zh: 他们可能对纳斯卡有点好奇。我的目标是，聊完之后，纳斯卡的粉丝比来之前更多。

subtitles.en: Our goals are aligned. Yeah, I love this. I just want to kick it off, Steve.
subtitles.zh: 我们的目标一致。太好了，我很喜欢。史蒂夫，我们就从你开始吧。

subtitles.en: You recently earlier this year became CEO of NASCAR.
subtitles.zh: 今年早些时候，你成为了纳斯卡的CEO。

subtitles.en: The first non-France family member ever to lead the sport.
subtitles.zh: 是首位非弗朗斯家族成员领导这项运动。

subtitles.en: But you're not, you're not new at all. You've been in NASCAR for 30 years.
subtitles.zh: 但你并不是新人，你在纳斯卡已经30年了。

subtitles.en: I'm curious just to know your mindset going into this new role.
subtitles.zh: 我很好奇，你担任这个新角色时的心态是怎样的。

subtitles.en: I also know your background. You have a baseball background.
subtitles.zh: 我也了解你的背景，你有棒球方面的经历。

subtitles.en: You come from other sports too. So how are you approaching now this new role at NASCAR?
subtitles.zh: 你也来自其他运动领域。那么你现在如何应对纳斯卡的这个新角色？
zh_highlights: 应对纳斯卡的这个新角色

subtitles.en: What are the vulnerabilities and also the assets that you see?
subtitles.zh: 您认为哪些是薄弱环节，哪些又是优势？

subtitles.en: Yeah, I think if you look at NASCAR as a sport right now, we're really solid foundation on a growth spurt this year.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，我觉得现在看纳斯卡赛车，基础非常扎实，今年正处在增长期。

subtitles.en: But I think we would be really not taking advantage of the future if we kind of rested on our laurels and said, hey, we're seeing some metrics that are up.
subtitles.zh: 但如果我们固步自封，说指标在涨，那就没有把握未来。

subtitles.en: So the opportunity right now is to go around, talk to guys like Tyler, who are superstars in the sport, about we're going to put on a good race week by week.
subtitles.zh: 所以现在的机会是，和泰勒这样的明星车手聊聊，我们每周都会呈现精彩比赛。

subtitles.en: But where do we want to go five years from now? And what are the big things we can align on as a sport and really attack those?
subtitles.zh: 但五年后我们要走向哪里？哪些大事能让我们团结一致去攻克？

大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费

让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里

只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
